decision.explanation: The question asks which sports teams Abel Thermeus represents or has represented. From the original sources, D1S1 and D1S16 explicitly state that Abel is a member of the Victoria cricket team. D2S2 and D2S5 indicate that he has been part of Motherwell F.C.'s squad as a footballer. These are distinct teams in different sports (cricket and football), and both are supported by direct evidence from the documents. There is no contradiction between these claims since they refer to different sports and teams. Candidate C2 ('football team') is too generic and lacks specificity compared to the named team 'Motherwell F.C.', so it is not accepted.
